descriptor: World clock and meeting overlap board

voice.summary: Anywhen sounds like a well-travelled friend glancing at their watch: relaxed, exact and a little poetic about daylight. It uses city names and local times, never abbreviations alone.
dos: Pair every time with a city name
Describe day or night in one word
Say plainly when there is no overlap
donts: Do not use only UTC offsets
Avoid ambiguous 12-hour times without am or pm

boilerplate: Anywhen is a world clock board that shows analogue and digital time for any city, tints each card by time of day and highlights shared working hours.

microcopy.error: That city was not found. Check the spelling.

logo.note: A clock dial is the most direct sign for a world clock.
